title: षट्षष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 166 · Bhishma counts the Pandava warriors

summary.en: Bhishma says the burden of the war rests on him and he will bear it, and turns to the Pandava side, rating Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, the twins and the sons of Draupadi, and describing their might and the huge size of the Pandava brothers.
summary.kn: ಯುದ್ಧದ ಭಾರ ತನ್ನ ಮೇಲಿದೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ಹೊರುವೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ಪಾಂಡವಪಕ್ಷದತ್ತ ತಿರುಗಿ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ, ಭೀಮ, ಅರ್ಜುನ, ಅವಳಿಗಳು, ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ ಅವರ ಬಲವನ್ನೂ ಪಾಂಡವಸಹೋದರರ ಭಾರೀ ಗಾತ್ರವನ್ನೂ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म कहते हैं कि युद्ध का भार उन पर है और वे उसे उठाएँगे, और पाण्डव पक्ष की ओर मुड़कर युधिष्ठिर, भीम, अर्जुन, जुड़वाँ भाइयों और द्रौपदी के पुत्रों का मूल्यांकन करते हैं, और उनके बल तथा पाण्डव भाइयों के विशाल डील-डौल का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: యుద్ధభారం తనపై ఉందని, దానిని మోస్తానని చెప్పి భీష్ముడు పాండవపక్షం వైపు తిరిగి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు, భీముడు, అర్జునుడు, కవలలు, ద్రౌపది కుమారులను అంచనా వేసి వారి బలాన్ని, పాండవ సోదరుల భారీ ఆకారాన్ని వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: போரின் பாரம் தம் மேல் உள்ளது, அதைச் சுமப்பேன் என்று சொல்லிப் பீஷ்மர் பாண்டவப் பக்கம் திரும்பி யுதிஷ்டிரர், பீமன், அர்ஜுனன், இரட்டையர், திரௌபதியின் மைந்தர்களை மதிப்பிட்டு, அவர்கள் வலிமையையும் பாண்டவச் சகோதரர்களின் பேருருவையும் விவரிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: യുദ്ധത്തിന്റെ ഭാരം തന്റെ മേലാണെന്നും, അത് താൻ വഹിക്കുമെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; പിന്നെ പാണ്ഡവപക്ഷത്തേക്ക് തിരിഞ്ഞ്, യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ, ഭീമൻ, അർജുനൻ, ഇരട്ടകൾ, ദ്രൗപദിയുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ എന്നിവരെ വിലയിരുത്തുന്നു; അവരുടെ ശക്തിയും പാണ്ഡവസഹോദരന്മാരുടെ വലിയ ശരീരവലുപ്പവും അദ്ദേഹം വർണ്ണിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.166; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
समुद्यतोऽयं भारो मे सुमहान्सागरोपमः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संग्रामे वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितः ॥

meaning.en: This great burden, like the ocean, that Dhritarashtra's son has brooded over for many years, has been raised on me for the battle.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नभ्यागते काले प्रतप्ते लोमहर्षणे ।
मिथोभेदो न मे कार्यस्तेन जीवसि सूतज ॥

meaning.en: Now that the time has come, blazing and hair-raising, I must not create a quarrel among us; that is why you still live, son of a charioteer.

verses.text:
न ह्यहं नाद्य विक्रम्य स्थविरोऽपि शिशोस्तव ।
युद्धश्रद्धां रणे छिन्द्यां जीवितस्य च सूतज ॥

meaning.en: Though I am old and you a child, I would not today fail in boldness to cut your zeal for battle, and for life, son of a charioteer.

verses.text:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण महास्त्राणि प्रमुञ्चता ।
न मे व्यथाभवत्काचित्त्वं तु मे किं करिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: When Rama son of Jamadagni let loose his great weapons, I felt no pain; what will you do to me?

verses.text:
कामं नैतत्प्रशंसन्ति सन्तोऽऽत्मबलसंस्तवम् ।
वक्ष्यामि तु त्वां संतप्तो निहीन कुलपांसन ॥

meaning.en: The good do not praise such self-praise; but, tormented, I will tell you, low one, disgrace of your family.

verses.text:
समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं काशिराज्ञः स्वयंवरे ।
निर्जित्यैकरथेनैव यत्कन्यास्तरसा हृताः ॥

meaning.en: When the Kshatriya kings gathered at the Kashi king's self-choice, I defeated them with a single chariot and carried off the maidens by force.

verses.text:
ईदृशानां सहस्राणि विशिष्टानामथो पुनः ।
मयैकेन निरस्तानि ससैन्यानि रणाजिरे ॥

meaning.en: Thousands like these, and better, I alone routed with their armies in the battlefield.

verses.text:
त्वां प्राप्य वैरपुरुषं कुरूणामनयो महान् ।
उपस्थितो विनाशाय यतस्व पुरुषो भव ॥

meaning.en: Meeting you, a man of enmity, a great misfortune has arisen for the Kurus, ready for their destruction; strive, be a man.

verses.text:
युध्यस्व पार्थं समरे येन विस्पर्धसे सह ।
द्रक्ष्यामि त्वां विनिर्मुक्तमस्माद्युद्धात्सुदुर्मते ॥

meaning.en: Fight Partha in battle, whom you rival; I shall see you freed from this war, if you can, foolish one.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तमुवाच ततो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः ।
मामवेक्षस्व गाङ्गेय कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the high-minded son of Dhritarashtra said to him: Son of Ganga, look to me, for a great task has been undertaken.

verses.text:
चिन्त्यतामिदमेवाग्रे मम निःश्रेयसं परम् ।
उभावपि भवन्तौ मे महत्कर्म करिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Think of this first, my highest good; both of you will do great work for me.

verses.text:
भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि परेषां रथसत्तमान् ।
ये चैवातिरथास्तत्र तथैव रथयूथपाः ॥

meaning.en: And I wish to hear more about the enemy's best chariot-warriors, the atirathas and the leaders of the chariot-fighters.

verses.text:
बलाबलममित्राणां श्रोतुमिच्छामि कौरव ।
प्रभातायां रजन्यां वै इदं युद्धं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Kaurava, I want to hear the strengths and weaknesses of our foes; for this battle will come at daybreak.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एते रथास्ते संख्यातास्तथैवातिरथा नृप ।
ये चाप्यर्धरथा राजन्पाण्डवानामतः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: These are the chariot-warriors counted for you, and the atirathas, king; now hear of the Pandavas' chariot-warriors and half-chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
यदि कौतूहलं तेऽद्य पाण्डवानां बले नृप ।
रथसंख्यां महाबाहो सहैभिर्वसुधाधिपैः ॥

meaning.en: If you are curious today about the Pandava army, mighty-armed king, hear the count of chariot-warriors along with these kings.

verses.text:
स्वयं राजा रथोदारः पाण्डवः कुन्तिनन्दनः ।
अग्निवत्समरे तात चरिष्यति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava king himself, Kunti's son, is a noble chariot-warrior; he will move through battle like fire, there is no doubt.

verses.text:
भीमसेनस्तु राजेन्द्र रथोऽष्टगुणसंमितः ।
नागायुतबलो मानी तेजसा न स मानुषः ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, king of kings, is counted as eightfold chariot-warrior, with the strength of ten thousand elephants, proud, and not human in splendor.

verses.text:
माद्रीपुत्रौ तु रथिनौ द्वावेव पुरुषर्षभौ ।
अश्विनाविव रूपेण तेजसा च समन्वितौ ॥

meaning.en: The sons of Madri are two chariot-warriors, bulls among men, with the beauty and splendor of the Ashvins themselves.

verses.text:
एते चमूमुखगताः स्मरन्तः क्लेशमात्मनः ।
रुद्रवत्प्रचरिष्यन्ति तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः ॥

meaning.en: These, at the front of the army, remembering their own suffering, will range like Rudra; of that I have no doubt.

verses.text:
सर्व एव महात्मानः शालस्कन्धा इवोद्गताः ।
प्रादेशेनाधिकाः पुम्भिरन्यैस्ते च प्रमाणतः ॥

meaning.en: All these great-souled men have grown like sal trunks, a span taller than other men.

verses.text:
सिंहसंहननाः सर्वे पाण्डुपुत्रा महाबलाः ।
चरितब्रह्मचर्याश्च सर्वे चातितपस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: All the sons of Pandu are lion-bodied and very strong, all practiced in celibacy and great ascetics.

verses.text:
ह्रीमन्तः पुरुषव्याघ्रा व्याघ्रा इव बलोत्कटाः ।
जवे प्रहारे संमर्दे सर्व एवातिमानुषाः ।
सर्वे जितमहीपाला दिग्जये भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Modest tigers among men, they are as fierce in strength as tigers; in speed, striking and crushing in battle all are superhuman; all conquered kings in their conquest of the directions, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
न चैषां पुरुषाः केचिदायुधानि गदाः शरान् ।
विषहन्ति सदा कर्तुमधिज्यान्यपि कौरव ।
उद्यन्तुं वा गदां गुर्वीं शरान्वापि प्रकर्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: No men of any kind can bear to string their weapons, maces and arrows, Kaurava, nor lift their heavy maces or draw their arrows.

verses.text:
जवे लक्ष्यस्य हरणे भोज्ये पांसुविकर्षणे ।
बालैरपि भवन्तस्तैः सर्व एव विशेषिताः ॥

meaning.en: In speed, hitting the target, eating and kicking up dust, all of you were surpassed by them even as boys.

verses.text:
ते ते सैन्यं समासाद्य व्याघ्रा इव बलोत्कटाः ।
विध्वंसयिष्यन्ति रणे मा स्म तैः सह संगमः ॥

meaning.en: Those tigers, having reached your army, will smash it in battle, strong as tigers; let there be no encounter with them.

verses.text:
एकैकशस्ते संग्रामे हन्युः सर्वान्महीक्षितः ।
प्रत्यक्षं तव राजेन्द्र राजसूये यथाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: One by one in battle they could kill all the kings, as happened before your eyes at the Rajasuya, king of kings.

verses.text:
द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं द्यूते च परुषा गिरः ।
ते संस्मरन्तः संग्रामे विचरिष्यन्ति कालवत् ॥

meaning.en: Remembering Draupadi's torment and the harsh words at the dice, they will move in battle like Death.

verses.text:
लोहिताक्षो गुडाकेशो नारायणसहायवान् ।
उभयोः सेनयोर्वीर रथो नास्तीह तादृशः ॥

meaning.en: Red-eyed Gudakesha, with Narayana as his helper: no chariot-warrior in either army is like him, hero.

verses.text:
न हि देवेषु वा पूर्वं दानवेषूरगेषु वा ।
राक्षसेष्वथ यक्षेषु नरेषु कुत एव तु ॥

meaning.en: Not before among gods, danavas, nagas, rakshasas or yakshas, much less among men,

verses.text:
भूतोऽथ वा भविष्यो वा रथः कश्चिन्मया श्रुतः ।
समायुक्तो महाराज यथा पार्थस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: Have I heard of any chariot, past or future, so well equipped, great king, as that of the wise Partha.

verses.text:
वासुदेवश्च संयन्ता योद्धा चैव धनंजयः ।
गाण्डीवं च धनुर्दिव्यं ते चाश्वा वातरंहसः ॥

meaning.en: Vasudeva is the charioteer and Dhananjaya the fighter; the bow is the divine Gandiva, and those horses are swift as wind.

verses.text:
अभेद्यं कवचं दिव्यमक्षय्यौ च महेषुधी ।
अस्त्रग्रामश्च माहेन्द्रो रौद्रः कौबेर एव च ॥

meaning.en: His armor is divine and unbreakable, his two great quivers are unfailing; he has the multitude of weapons of Mahendra, Rudra, Kubera,

verses.text:
याम्यश्च वारुणश्चैव गदाश्चोग्रप्रदर्शनाः ।
वज्रादीनि च मुख्यानि नानाप्रहरणानि वै ॥

meaning.en: Yama and Varuna, and fearsome maces, and many chief weapons beginning with the thunderbolt.

verses.text:
दानवानां सहस्राणि हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम् ।
हतान्येकरथेनाजौ कस्तस्य सदृशो रथः ॥

meaning.en: Thousands of danavas living in Hiranyapura were killed in battle by a single chariot; what chariot is like his?

verses.text:
एष हन्याद्धि संरम्भी बलवान्सत्यविक्रमः ।
तव सेनां महाबाहुः स्वां चैव परिपालयन् ॥

meaning.en: Enraged, strong and true in valor, that mighty-armed man would destroy your army, while protecting his own.

verses.text:
अहं चैनं प्रत्युदियामाचार्यो वा धनंजयम् ।
न तृतीयोऽस्ति राजेन्द्र सेनयोरुभयोरपि ।
य एनं शरवर्षाणि वर्षन्तमुदियाद्रथी ॥

meaning.en: I or the teacher, Drona, may face Dhananjaya; there is no third in either army, king, who as a chariot-warrior could rise against him as he showers arrows.

verses.text:
जीमूत इव घर्मान्ते महावातसमीरितः ।
समायुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयो वासुदेवसहायवान् ।
तरुणश्च कृती चैव जीर्णावावामुभावपि ॥

meaning.en: Like a cloud at the end of summer driven by a great wind, the son of Kunti is well equipped, with Vasudeva as helper; he is young and skilled, while we two are old.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु भीष्मस्य राज्ञां दध्वंसिरे तदा ।
काञ्चनाङ्गदिनः पीना भुजाश्चन्दनरूषिताः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this from Bhishma, the arms of the kings, stout, gold-armleted and smeared with sandalwood, drooped then.

verses.text:
मनोभिः सह सावेगैः संस्मृत्य च पुरातनम् ।
सामर्थ्यं पाण्डवेयानां यथाप्रत्यक्षदर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: With their minds agitated, they remembered the old might of the Pandavas as if seen with their eyes.
